summary: Simulated shell with phosphor-flash output, dotted progress bars and a glowing block caret; runs a set of built-in demo commands.

attributes.name: autorun
attributes.description: Command typed automatically 0.9 s after the element first connects.

events.name: command
events.description: Fires when a non-empty command runs, before its output. `command` is trimmed.

methods.description: Runs a command as if it were typed and Enter pressed. Ignored while another command is running.
Types the command into the prompt character by character, then runs it.
Appends an output line and returns it. `cls` can be `dim`, `ok`, `err` or `acc` to colour it.

keyboard.action: Step back and forward through the command history.

accessibility: The command input has `aria-label="Terminal command"`; the prompt glyph is `aria-hidden`.
The input is disabled while a command runs, and focus returns to it afterwards if it had focus.
Progress rows are `role="progressbar"` elements with an `aria-label` (`tests`, `build`, `upload` or the agent name) and `aria-valuenow`; the percentage is also shown as text.
The phosphor flash, progress dots and caret are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas.
motion: With reduced motion waits are capped at 60 ms, so typing and progress finish almost at once, bars fill without easing and the caret does not blink; the brief flash behind new lines still shows.
notes: Commands and output are built-in demo content: `help`, `ls`, `test` (also `npm … test`), `deploy`, `ultracode` and `clear`. Anything else prints `command not found`.
The terminal uses fixed dark colours in both themes.
The output area is 196px tall and keeps the last 120 lines.

data.note: Commands and their output are built-in demo content; `print()` adds your own lines.
